answer: At each epoch, agents must post a notarized log of copper-mining and timber-hauling in peer-verified harbors on a sharded ocean ledger. The log’s confirmations decay after 48 hours unless refreshed with freshly timestamped proofs. Each fake identity needs unique, real-time footage of distinct ports; bulk-drone footage triggers auto-flag. One fake demands 48 hours of fresh copper shipments or burns 12 hours of reputation decay—scales linearly, no shortcuts.
